description: Default permissions for Clauge main (dashboard) window. The dashboard loads via WebviewUrl::External(http://127.0.0.1:<port>/) so the SEA sidecar serves it directly. By default Tauri 2 only injects window.__TAURI__ for tauri:// scheme content; the `remote.urls` block here opts the dashboard webview into IPC access for the bundled HTTP origins it actually loads. The `allow-*` entries with no plugin prefix are app-level (`__app-acl__`) permissions autogenerated from build.rs APP_COMMANDS — without them Tauri 2 rejects custom `#[tauri::command]` calls from a non-local origin (tauri-2.11.1/src/webview/mod.rs:1823).
